properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 16 at 3:40AM CDT until October 17 at 4:00PM CDT by NWS Austin/San Antonio TX
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Pecos River Near Langtry affecting Val Verde County.

Rio Grande At Foster Ranch affecting Val Verde County.

Devils River At Bakers Crossing 19N Of Comstock affecting Val Verde
County.

...The Flood Warning is cancelled for the following rivers in
Texas...

Devils River At Cauthorn Ranch Near Juno affecting Val Verde
County.

Pecos River At Pandale Crossing affecting Val Verde County.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Devils River at Bakers Crossing 19N Of Comstock.

* WHEN...From this evening to Saturday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 6.0 feet, (1.8 meters), Minor lowland flooding extends
into low areas of the flood plain with no significant impact.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 2:15 AM CDT Friday the stage was 2.8 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 4.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage this
evening to a crest of 6.2 feet late this evening. It will then
fall below flood stage late tonight.
- Flood stage is 6.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Even 6 inches of fast-moving flood water can knock you off your feet
and a depth of 2 feet will float your car. Never try to walk, swim,
or drive through such swift water. If you come upon flood waters,
stop, turn around and go another way.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued early this morning at 445 AM CDT.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING NOW IN EFFECT FROM THIS EVENING TO SATURDAY AFTERNOON

afternoon and continue into this evening with an isolated
thunderstorm or two possible. Conditions will become quite

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 16 at 4:21AM EDT by NWS Blacksburg VA
properties.description:
Pockets of fog, which, will be dense at times will be present
through the morning commute across the area. This may lead to
difficult driving conditions as visibilities will be reduced down
to 1/4 mile or less in localized areas. Drivers are recommended to
leave early to account for slow commute times this morning and
only use low beam headlights.

properties.areaDesc: Cotton, OK
properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 16 at 3:04AM CDT until October 17 at 1:00PM CDT by NWS Norman OK
properties.description:
...The Flood Advisory continues for the following rivers in
Oklahoma...

Deep Red Creek near Randlett affecting Cotton County.

For the Deep Red Creek...including Randlett...elevated river levels
are forecast.

* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Deep Red Creek near Randlett.

* WHEN...Until Saturday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 19.0 feet, Some flooding of bottomlands may occur
along and near the creek.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 2:30 AM CDT Friday the stage was 19.1 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 20.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 19.3 feet
this morning.
- Action stage is 17.0 feet.
- Flood stage is 20.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this afternoon at 315 PM CDT.

properties.areaDesc: Wichita, TX; Wilbarger, TX
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 16 at 3:02AM CDT until October 20 at 1:00AM CDT by NWS Norman OK
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Beaver Creek near Electra affecting Wichita and Wilbarger Counties.

For the Beaver Creek (NW TX)...including Electra...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Beaver Creek near Electra.

* WHEN...From late Saturday night to late Monday night.

* IMPACTS...At 26.0 feet, Flood levels up to 2 feet in depth cover
farm and range lands... and may inundate some oil and gas
facilities... along and near the creek in southern Wilbarger County
and southwestern Wichita County.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 2:00 AM CDT Friday the stage was 22.4 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 24.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 25.7 feet
Sunday evening. It will then fall below flood stage Monday
evening.
- Flood stage is 24.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 25.7
feet on 06/04/1981.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this afternoon at 315 PM CDT.
